title: Washington Law: RCW 19.28
briefing: Washington State electrical law — RCW 19.28. Separately scored on the real exam, so it gets its own level here. Ten questions, 70% to pass.

questions.prompt: Under RCW 19.28.006, how is 'Basic electrical work Class A' defined?
choices: Electrical wiring of residential structures not exceeding three stories and including not more than four dwelling units, or agricultural buildings
Electrical wiring of residential structures not exceeding two stories and including not more than four dwelling units
Electrical wiring of residential structures not exceeding three stories and including not more than two dwelling units
Electrical wiring of any residential structure regardless of stories or number of dwelling units
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.006: 'Basic electrical work Class A' means electrical wiring of residential structures not exceeding three stories in height and including not more than four dwelling units, or agricultural buildings.

questions.prompt: Under RCW 19.28.006, what distinguishes 'Basic electrical work Class B' from Class A?
choices: Class B covers structures with not more than one dwelling unit; Class A covers up to four dwelling units
Class B covers structures with not more than two dwelling units; Class A covers up to four dwelling units
Class B covers agricultural buildings only; Class A covers residential structures
Class B covers structures not exceeding two stories; Class A covers structures not exceeding three stories
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.006: 'Basic electrical work Class B' means electrical wiring of residential structures not exceeding three stories in height and including not more than one dwelling unit, whereas Class A allows up to four dwelling units.

questions.prompt: According to RCW 19.28.006, the term 'Administrator' refers to which of the following?
choices: A person who qualifies for a contractor's license by passing the required exams
The Director of the Department of Labor and Industries
A member of the Washington State electrical board
A person who supervises trainee electricians on a job site
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.006: 'Administrator' means the person who qualifies for a contractor's license by passing the required examinations.

questions.prompt: Under RCW 19.28.006, which body is defined as the 'Board'?
choices: Washington State electrical board
Washington State Department of Labor and Industries
Washington State Building Code Council
The Governor's Office of Regulatory Compliance
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.006: 'Board' means the Washington State electrical board established under this chapter.

choices: Replacement of existing equipment with equipment of the same type and rating
Replacement of existing equipment with equipment of higher capacity and updated code compliance
Installation of any new equipment in place of removed outdated equipment
Repair of existing equipment without substitution of any components
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.006: 'Like-in-kind' means replacement of existing equipment with equipment of the same type and rating.

questions.prompt: Under RCW 19.28.041, how long does an electrical contractor license remain valid after issuance?
choices: 24 calendar months
12 calendar months
36 calendar months
18 calendar months
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.041: Electrical contractor licenses expire 24 calendar months after the date of issuance.

questions.prompt: What is the required bond amount for an electrical contractor license under RCW 19.28.041 and RCW 19.28.071?
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.041 and RCW 19.28.071: The required bond is $4,000 with the state of Washington as obligee, or a cash deposit of $4,000 as an alternative.

questions.prompt: Under RCW 19.28.041, which of the following is NOT listed as a required application element for an electrical contractor license?
choices: A copy of the applicant's journey level electrician certificate
UBI number
Workers' compensation account number
Excise tax registration number
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.041: Required application elements include UBI number, workers' compensation account number, employment security account number, and excise tax registration number. A journey level certificate is not listed as a contractor license application requirement.

questions.prompt: According to RCW 19.28.041, who must be designated to qualify an electrical contractor license?
choices: A master electrician or administrator
A journey level electrician or specialty electrician
A state-licensed inspector or department employee
A board-approved safety officer
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.041: An electrical contractor license must designate a master electrician or administrator to qualify the license.

questions.prompt: Under RCW 19.28.091, a homeowner is exempt from electrical contractor licensing requirements when performing electrical work on their own single-family dwelling, provided the home is NOT offered for sale within how many months of the work?
choices: 12 months
6 months
24 months
18 months
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.091: The owner of a single-family dwelling may perform their own electrical work without a contractor license, provided the work is not for hire and the property is not offered for sale within 12 months of the work being completed.
